<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.
The evidence is the problem statement and the five most similar stories and roadmap pages, with status and dates.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is system failures/slowdowns when processing large batches of claims. I checked the five most similar items: the Summer and September release notes mention general performance improvements but are low-similarity (0.073, 0.054) and do not specifically address large-batch claim processing failures. Story 4133 (classifier confidence threshold) is unstarted and unrelated; the task overview page is unrelated; story 4127 (bulk document upload, completed) addresses document uploads, not batch claim processing performance. No completed story or roadmap item covers the same core problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
